title: Quenched Earthy Indian Duck-Confit-Leg Dal
description: A hearty, earthy, snappy Indian dish featuring slow-cooked duck leg confit with a rich, spiced lentil Dal, perfect for a lazy Sunday. Earthy notes from mustard and cumin add depth to this flexitarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat one tablespoon of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sweat one small onion, diced, for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add two minced cloves of garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add one cup of split red lentils, one cup of diced fresh tomatoes, and two cups of water to the pot, stirring to combine.
